source_snapshot.title: Enter Global Village for free on Saturday, November 7, if you visit on November 6
source_snapshot.text: Dubai: If one trip to Global Village is never enough for you, there is a weekend offer at the popular family destination – a limited number of visitors who buy entry tickets on November 6 will be able to enjoy free entry on November 7! Here’s how you can take advantage of the offer. How to get free entry to Global Village According to Global Village, those who visit the venue on November 6 (Friday) simply need to hold on to their ticket for the next day. On November 7 (Saturday), they would then need to present their ticket from the previous day at the Information Booth at the Gate of the World, to claim their complimentary ticket. It is important to note that the complimentary ticket is available for November 7 only, with only 3,100 complimentary tickets available, on a first-come, first-served basis.
